title: Professor's invisible prompt trap catches 32/35 students cheating with AI
summary: Professor Jason Gibson of Alcorn State University embedded hidden white-font instructions in a midterm question about the Industrial Revolution, telling AI to include nonsensical references to Madagascar. Of 35 students across two classes, 32 copied the prompt into a chatbot and pasted the output without reviewing it, resulting in bizarre phrases like "Madagascar floats sideways through the afternoon." Gibson failed all cheaters on that portion and allowed them to contest the grade—only two did. The article highlights the growing problem of AI-assisted cheating, noting a separate case at Brown University where take-home exam averages jumped from 65–80% to 96%, with the professor estimating all but two of 86 students used AI.

title: Yudkowsky and Soares' Book Is Lacking (2025)
summary:
The article criticizes Eliezer Yudkowsky and Nate Soares’ book *If Anyone Builds It, Everyone Dies* for lacking substantial evidence or analysis to support its central claim that superintelligent AI will soon emerge. Key points:

- The authors assert AI will be all-knowing and all-powerful but never explain how computers might achieve intelligence. They provide no discussion of AI’s operating principles or whether its correlation-finding capabilities could lead to genuine innovation or original thought.
- Examples cited (chess, protein folding, text generation) involve narrow, well-defined tasks with clear datasets and goals. The book assumes without justification that these domains are analogous to broader fields like scientific discovery.
- The authors contradict themselves: they admit humans don’t understand intelligence, that current AIs are “shallower than a twelve-year-old,” and that a “missing piece” remains—yet still insist superintelligence is imminent.
- Arguments rely on vague appeals: “researchers will figure it out,” “AI itself will solve the problem,” or “progress has been made in the past.” They also claim AI is inscrutable, but the article counters that we do know AI’s fundamental operation (correlation discovery), even if the scale is opaque.
- The book dismisses the scientific community’s skepticism as “folk theory and blind optimism,” but the article concludes that the authors’ own unsupported assertions are not compelling.
chinese_title: 尤德科夫斯基与索亚雷斯的著作存在不足（2025）
chinese_summary:
文章批评了埃利泽·尤德科夫斯基和内特·索雷斯合著的《If Anyone Builds It, Everyone Dies》一书，指出其核心主张——超级智能AI即将出现——缺乏实质性证据或分析。关键点如下：

- 作者断言AI将无所不知、无所不能，但从未解释计算机如何实现智能。他们既未讨论AI的运行原理，也未说明其相关性发现能力是否可能带来真正的创新或原创思想。
- 书中引用的例子（国际象棋、蛋白质折叠、文本生成）均涉及狭窄且定义明确的任务，具有清晰的数据集和目标。该书毫无根据地假设这些领域与更广泛的领域（如科学发现）相似。
- 作者自相矛盾：他们承认人类并不理解智能，当前AI“比十二岁孩子还肤浅”，且仍存在“缺失的一环”——却依然坚称超级智能即将来临。
- 论证依赖模糊的托词：“研究人员会搞定的”“AI自己会解决这个问题”或“过去已有进展”。他们还声称AI不可理解，但文章反驳称我们确实知道AI的基本运作方式（相关性发现），尽管其规模尚不透明。
- 该书将科学界的怀疑斥为“民间理论与盲目乐观”，但文章总结道，作者自身未经证实的论断并不可信。

title: The Birth of the American 12-string Guitar (2013)
summary:
Gregg Miner's article argues that the modern 12-string guitar evolved from earlier 10-string "harp-guitars," not from Mexican double-course instruments. The key figure is inventor Carl E. Brown, who patented a 10-string guitar in 1896 (Patent #568,108). Brown’s instrument featured four lower courses tuned in octaves, with a lever mechanism to silence the extra strings and convert it to a standard guitar. This design aimed to simplify amateur playing by allowing melodies in first position.

Brown’s invention was first produced by Hamilton Gordon (New York, 1897) and later by Rene Grunewald (New Orleans). Notably, Grunewald’s versions omitted Brown’s lever. A subsequent discovery showed that the Wurlitzer Company also manufactured a version with the original mechanism. Miner contends that this 10-string "harp-guitar"—coupled with influences from true harp guitars with floating strings—led to the standard 12-string guitar (six double courses, lower four in octaves). The article traces Brown's concept through magazine reports in *Music Trade Review* and *The Cadenza*, emphasizing that the added octave strings were not for a novel playing style but to extend the range of the common "bass solo" amateur technique. Miner concludes that the 12-string guitar likely has its overlooked origins in Brown’s 10-string instrument and its subsequent commercial adaptations.
chinese_title: 美国十二弦吉他的诞生（2013）
chinese_summary:
格雷格·迈纳的文章认为，现代12弦吉他并非源自墨西哥的双弦组乐器，而是从更早的10弦“竖琴吉他”演变而来。关键人物是发明家卡尔·E·布朗，他于1896年获得了一项10弦吉他专利（专利号568,108）。布朗的乐器配备四个以八度调音的低音弦组，并设计了一个杠杆机构来消除多余琴弦，使其可转换为标准吉他。这一设计旨在让业余演奏者能在第一把位轻松弹奏旋律。

布朗的发明最初由汉密尔顿·戈登（纽约，1897年）生产，随后由雷内·格鲁内瓦尔德（新奥尔良）接手。值得注意的是，格鲁内瓦尔德版本省略了布朗的杠杆。后续发现表明，沃利策公司也制造过保留原始机构的版本。迈纳指出，这种10弦“竖琴吉他”——结合了带有浮动琴弦的真正竖琴吉他的影响——最终催生了标准12弦吉他（六组双弦，低音四组为八度）。文章通过《音乐贸易评论》和《华彩乐段》杂志的报道追溯了布朗的设计理念，强调附加的八度琴弦并非为了创新弹奏风格，而是为了扩展业余爱好者常用的“低音独奏”技巧的音域。迈纳总结道，12弦吉他的起源很可能被忽视了，它源于布朗的10弦乐器及其后续的商业化改编。

title: I wanted a clock that never needed setting. Things escalated
summary: The author set out to build a self-setting bedside clock with a red seven-segment LED display, NTP time sync, automatic DST adjustment, and no phone app. Unable to find a commercial product, they used a Raspberry Pi Zero W/2W, an Adafruit 1.2-inch display with HT16K33 backpack, and a 3D-printed enclosure. They had never soldered before but learned. The software—written mostly by an LLM (Claude Code)—runs as a systemd service, uses the host OS for NTP, supports HomeKit via HAP-python, and includes brightness scheduling. Deployment is handled via Gitea Actions on a LAN-only server. The case was modified from a Creative Commons design using LLM-assisted Fusion 360 CAD. To reduce the display’s nighttime brightness, they added a 12% neutral density filter behind smoked acrylic, split into separate printed pieces with guide pins. The final clock meets all requirements: self-sets, stays accurate, dims on schedule, and integrates with iOS Home. The project took more waiting for supplies than actual work, thanks to LLMs handling coding and CAD. The author notes that an ESP32 could replace the Pi, and full build details are on GitHub.

title: Google Chrome Arrives on ARM64 Linux, Widevine DRM Included
summary: Google Chrome now has an official ARM64 Linux build, available for Debian and RPM-based distributions. title: Show HN: multiaes – hardware-accelerated, constant-time AES, two-file drop-in
summary:
**Summary of multiaes**

multiaes is a lightweight, constant-time, standalone AES library designed as a two-file drop-in with a simple API. It is hardware-accelerated on Intel (AES-NI, compile with `-maes`) and ARM (NEON crypto extensions, `-march=armv8-a+crypto`), with a software fallback when hardware support is unavailable. The library can be compiled to WebAssembly and includes a JavaScript wrapper.

The API provides:
- `aes_init()` to initialize a context with a key.
- `aes_encrypt_block()` and `aes_decrypt_block()` for single 16-byte block operations.
- `aes_clear()` to clear sensitive context data.

Future plans include adding AES-GCM and CMAC modes. The project is licensed under AGPL-3.0-only.

title: AI companies are shredding rare books
summary:
AI companies are purchasing rare books in bulk, using high-speed scanners that cut off the spines, then shredding the originals. A service called ISBNdb facilitates orders of up to one million books and keeps buyers anonymous. Pre-2022 books are particularly valuable because they contain no AI-generated text. A federal judge has ruled the practice legal as fair use, arguing that destroying the original means only one copy exists at a time. Anthropic hired the former head of Google Books partnerships to acquire "all the books in the world."

A bookseller told 404 Media that rare books with almost no surviving copies—works that survived wars, fires, and centuries—are being fed into this pipeline to train AI models. ISBNdb’s website acknowledges that "'AI company destroys two million books' is not a headline that generates sympathy," yet the company built its business around quiet destruction, offering NDAs as a feature and coaching clients to call it "digital preservation."

The author notes this is worse than scraping websites or torrenting libraries because the destruction is irreversible. While a website can be re-uploaded or a bestseller reprinted, the last three copies of an 18th-century botanical text cannot be replaced once shredded for training data. With a judge's ruling deeming it legal, the practice is expected to accelerate.

一位书商告诉404 Media，那些几乎已无存世副本的稀有书籍——历经战争、火灾与几个世纪幸存下来的作品——正被投入这条流水线以训练AI模型。ISBNdb的网站承认"'AI公司毁掉两百万本书'并非能引发同情的标题"，但该公司却围绕悄无声息的销毁构建业务，将保密协议作为卖点，并指导客户称之为"数字保存"。

title: Exercise works for depression. So why isn't it treated like real medicine?
summary: A growing body of research shows that exercise is as effective as antidepressants or therapy for many people with depression, yet it is rarely prescribed as a first-line treatment. The article highlights several reasons for this gap. First, doctors receive little training in exercise prescription and often default to medication due to time constraints. Second, unlike pills, exercise requires patient motivation, guidance, and consistency—factors that are difficult to standardize. Third, health insurance systems typically do not cover exercise programs for mental health, while they readily cover drugs. The article notes that even when exercise is recommended, it is often vague (“get more exercise”) rather than a specific, structured plan with dosage and frequency. Finally, cultural biases still view depression as a “chemical imbalance” best fixed by medication, despite evidence that lifestyle interventions can address root causes. The authors argue that exercise should be treated as “real medicine” – prescribed with clear protocols, supported by health systems, and integrated into treatment guidelines – to bridge the gap between evidence and practice.
chinese_title: 运动对抑郁症有效。那为什么它不被当作真正的药物？

title: Scriptc by Vercel: TypeScript-to-Native compiler, no JavaScript engine in binary
summary:
Scriptc is a TypeScript-to-native compiler from Vercel that produces small, fast executables without any JavaScript engine in the binary (by default). It compiles ordinary TypeScript—no special annotations—using the real TypeScript type checker. The compiler classifies code into three tiers: **static** (native code, no engine), **dynamic** (an embedded quickjs-ng engine for npm dependencies and code that can't be native), and **rejected** (with clear error codes and rewrite hints).  

Coverage analysis shows most TypeScript (≈99% in typical apps) compiles statically. The static surface includes classes, closures, generics, async/await on stackful fibers, JSON, regex, Node API (fs, http, net, crypto, etc.), and fetch. Correctness is enforced via differential testing (byte-for-byte match with Node on 800+ tests) and a memory-safety lane (AddressSanitizer + reference count audit).  

Performance highlights: startup ~2.4ms (vs Node's ~47ms), binary size 170–200KB static (~3MB with deps and engine), memory 1–4MB RSS. Scriptc also offers escape hatches: `comptime` for build-time execution, native FFI, checked casts, and `--dynamic` for npm dependencies.  

The architecture uses three packages: `compiler` (TS→typed IR→C/LLVM), `runtime` (C runtime with cycle collector, fibers, event loop), and `cli` (`build`, `run`, `coverage`). Every feature lands with differential tests.

覆盖率分析显示，大多数 TypeScript（典型应用中约 99%）可静态编译。静态层面支持类、闭包、泛型、基于栈式纤程的 async/await、JSON、正则表达式、Node API（fs、http、net、crypto 等）以及 fetch。正确性通过差异测试（与 Node 在 800 多项测试中逐字节匹配）和内存安全机制（AddressSanitizer + 引用计数审计）保障。

性能亮点：启动时间约 2.4 毫秒（Node 约 47 毫秒），静态二进制体积 170–200KB（含依赖和引擎约 3MB），内存占用 1–4MB RSS。Scriptc 还提供逃生舱机制：`comptime` 用于构建时执行、原生 FFI、安全检查转换以及 `--dynamic` 用于 npm 依赖。

架构包含三个包：`compiler`（TypeScript→类型化中间表示→C/LLVM）、`runtime`（含循环回收器、纤程、事件循环的 C 运行时）以及 `cli`（`build`、`run`、`coverage`）。每个特性均通过差异测试验证。

title: The Usefulness of Useless Knowledge (1939) [pdf]
summary:
Based on the title and known content of Abraham Flexner's 1939 essay, "The Usefulness of Useless Knowledge," here is a concise summary:

Flexner argues that the most significant scientific and intellectual advancements often arise from the pursuit of knowledge for its own sake, without any immediate practical application. He champions "useless" knowledge—theoretical and curiosity-driven research—as the essential foundation for major breakthroughs.

He offers historical examples, such as the work of physicists like James Clerk Maxwell, whose theoretical equations were later crucial for the development of radio and wireless communication. Flexner contrasts this with a narrow focus on "useful" or applied science, arguing that such an approach stifles the creative and deep thinking required for genuine innovation.

Flexner, the founding director of the Institute for Advanced Study (which hosted Einstein), insists that institutions must protect and fund pure research, allowing brilliant minds the freedom and resources to explore ideas without pressure for immediate results. He concludes that society's greatest practical benefits emerge from a culture that values and supports curiosity, intellectual exploration, and the seemingly impractical quest for understanding.
chinese_title: 无用知识的有用性（1939）[pdf]
chinese_summary:
根据亚伯拉罕·弗莱克斯纳1939年文章《无用知识的有用性》的标题和已知内容，以下为简明总结：

弗莱克斯纳认为，最重大的科学和智力进步往往源于为知识本身而进行的探索，即便这些探索没有直接的实用价值。他推崇“无用”知识——即基于好奇心和理论驱动的研究——将其视为重大突破的根本基石。

他以历史实例为证，如物理学家詹姆斯·克拉克·麦克斯韦的理论方程后来对无线电和无线通信的发展至关重要。弗莱克斯纳将这种研究与狭隘关注“有用”或应用科学的方式相对比，认为后者会扼杀真正创新所需的创造性和深度思考。

作为（曾容纳爱因斯坦的）高等研究院创始院长，弗莱克斯纳坚持认为，机构必须保护并资助纯理论研究，让天才们拥有自由和资源去探索思想，而不受即时成果的压力。他总结道，社会最大的实际效益恰恰源于一种珍视并支持好奇心、智力探索以及看似无用的求知欲的文化。

title: 108 PRs in eight days: Accidentally discovering loop engineering
summary:
The article describes how the author used an AI agent to autonomously process 108 pull requests in eight days—dramatically up from their previous 5–10 per week. Key enablers include a small, high-trust team without mandatory human code review (review shifted to the testing stage) and the absence of continuous deployment, which allowed batching releases to limit risk.

The author discovered "loop engineering" (a term by Addy Osmani): designing a system that prompts agents rather than typing every prompt. Their setup has three layers:

- **Protocol**: a markdown file with rules (status meanings, merge criteria, etc.) living next to the board.
- **Loop**: reads the board, dispatches work, updates task frontmatter; writes no code.
- **Worker**: writes code in an isolated worktree, never touches the board or talks to the author directly.

The board uses one markdown file per task to avoid collisions. Workers run in isolated worktrees so the author’s local state never interferes. The loop runs self-paced (no fixed interval) and stops automatically when no tasks can proceed, saving tokens. A memory file (with a hard cap) tracks learned facts and recurring bugs, which may become new tasks.

The author’s bottleneck shifted to spec and QA work: adding tasks and testing results. Next steps include automating testing and verification. The setup is open-sourced, with advice to start by defining "done" precisely.
chinese_title: 八天内108个PR：偶然发现循环工程
chinese_summary:

作者发现了“循环工程”（Addy Osmani提出的术语）：设计一个系统来提示代理，而不是手动输入每条提示。其架构分为三层：

- **协议**：一个包含规则（状态含义、合并标准等）的Markdown文件，与看板并存。
- **循环**：读取看板，分发任务，更新任务前置元数据；不编写代码。
- **执行器**：在隔离的工作树中编写代码，从不接触看板，也不直接与作者沟通。

看板使用每个任务一个Markdown文件的方式以避免冲突。执行器在隔离的工作树中运行，因此作者的本地状态不会干扰。循环以自定节奏运行（无固定间隔），并在无任务可进行时自动停止，从而节省令牌。一个内存文件（设有硬上限）记录已学到的知识和反复出现的错误，这些可能成为新任务。

作者的瓶颈已转向规格说明和QA工作：添加任务并测试结果。下一步计划包括自动化测试与验证。该方案已开源，建议从精确定义“完成”开始。

title: Could a Neuroscientist Understand a Microprocessor?(2017)
summary: The article "Could a Neuroscientist Understand a Microprocessor?" (2017) by Jonas and Kording tests whether popular neuroscience data-analysis methods can reveal how a complex, well-understood system processes information. Using the MOS 6502 microprocessor as a "model organism," the authors apply techniques such as tuning curves, connectivity analysis, and lesion studies to its transistor-level activity while running classic video games (Donkey Kong, Space Invaders, Pitfall). Despite having complete, noise-free data and full experimental access, these methods produced interesting statistical patterns but failed to uncover the hierarchical, modular information processing that computer engineers understand—such as registers, ALUs, and instruction cycles. The authors argue that big data alone is insufficient for meaningful understanding; current neuroscience approaches may similarly fall short when applied to the brain. They advocate using complex artificial systems with known ground truth as validation platforms to test and refine analytical methods before applying them to neural systems.

title: Decker, a platform that builds on the legacy of Hypercard and classic macOS

Finished projects can be saved as self-contained HTML files that run in any browser, and Decker runs natively on MacOS, Windows, BSD, and Linux.

title: Measuring developer productivity with the DX Core 4
summary:

title: If Scrubs Hurt, Your ZFS Design Is Broken
summary:
If scrubs cause noticeable production latency, the underlying ZFS pool design is likely flawed—not the scrub itself. Scrubs run at the lowest I/O priority; if they degrade performance, the pool lacks IOPS headroom for essential maintenance. Common mistakes include sizing pools purely for capacity and price while ignoring the IOPS demands of scrubs, resilvers, and other background tasks. High fill ratios (85–95%) and wide RAIDZ VDEVs fragment metadata, turning scrub metadata traversal into a random-read bottleneck.

The fix is not more spindles but targeted metadata offload: add a **special VDEV**—a mirrored set of enterprise SSDs/NVMe drives—to store all pool metadata (indirect blocks, dnodes, etc.). This moves the random-read metadata workload to fast media while spinning disks handle sequential data reads. The `special_small_blocks` property can also redirect small file data. Sizing is minimal (often <1% of pool capacity) and costs a low single-digit percentage of hardware budget.

A pool that cannot scrub safely cannot resilver safely—scrubs are rehearsals for real failures. Offloading metadata converts maintenance from a monthly incident into background noise, ensuring data integrity without sacrificing production performance.
chinese_title: 若Scrub操作痛苦，则你的ZFS设计存在缺陷。
chinese_summary:
如果清理操作导致明显的生产延迟，底层ZFS存储池的设计很可能存在缺陷——而非清理操作本身的问题。清理操作以最低I/O优先级运行；若其导致性能下降，说明存储池缺乏用于必要维护的IOPS余量。常见错误包括仅按容量和价格规划存储池规模，而忽略了清理、重建及其他后台任务对IOPS的需求。高填充率（85-95%）和宽RAIDZ虚拟设备会导致元数据碎片化，使清理操作的元数据遍历变成随机读取瓶颈。

解决方案并非增加更多机械硬盘，而是针对性地卸载元数据：添加一个**专用虚拟设备**——一组企业级SSD/NVMe驱动器组成的镜像集——用于存储所有池元数据（间接块、dnodes等）。这样可将随机读取元数据的工作负载转移到快速介质，而机械硬盘仅处理顺序数据读取。`special_small_blocks`属性还可重定向小文件数据。所需空间极小（通常不到池容量的1%），成本仅占硬件预算的低个位数百分比。

无法安全执行清理的存储池也无法安全执行重建——清理正是对真实故障的预演。卸载元数据可将维护任务从每月的事故变为背景噪音，在确保数据完整性的同时不牺牲生产性能。

summary:
The provided content appears to be raw PDF binary data rather than readable text, making it impossible to extract the article's actual content. However, based on the title "Introduction to Data-Oriented Design," a typical summary of this topic is as follows:

Data-Oriented Design (DOD) is a programming paradigm focused on optimizing data layout and access patterns for performance, particularly in game development and real-time systems. It emphasizes designing data structures around how data is actually used in computation, rather than around objects or abstractions. Key principles include:
- **Data Locality:** Organizing data contiguously in memory to maximize cache efficiency (e.g., using arrays of structs instead of arrays of pointers).
- **Batch Processing:** Processing homogeneous data in bulk (e.g., updating all positions at once) to reduce branching and leverage SIMD instructions.
- **Minimizing Indirection:** Avoiding pointers, virtual functions, and dynamic dispatch that cause unpredictable memory access.
- **Separation of Concerns:** Keeping data separate from logic, allowing easy transformation and reuse.
- **Profiling-Driven Design:** Base decisions on actual hardware performance measurements.

DOD contrasts with Object-Oriented Design, which often bundles data with behavior but can lead to scattered memory access and poor cache utilization. Common techniques include using structs of arrays (SoA) over arrays of structs (AoS), manual memory management, and designing systems as data pipelines. DOD is widely used in high-performance game engines, physics simulations, and real-time graphics.

- **数据局部性：** 将数据在内存中连续组织以最大化缓存效率（例如，使用结构体数组而非指针数组）。
- **批量处理：** 批量处理同质数据（例如，一次性更新所有位置），以减少分支并利用SIMD指令。

数据导向设计与面向对象设计形成对比，后者常将数据与行为捆绑，但可能导致分散的内存访问和较差的缓存利用率。常用技术包括使用结构体数组（SoA）而非数组结构体（AoS）、手动内存管理以及将系统设计为数据管道。数据导向设计广泛应用于高性能游戏引擎、物理模拟和实时图形学中。

title: How Unix spell ran in 64 kB of RAM (2025)
summary:
The article details how Douglas McIlroy implemented Unix's spell checker on the PDP‑11, fitting a 250 kB dictionary into 64 kB of RAM. Steve Johnson’s initial prototype used disk lookups and was slow and inaccurate. McIlroy first built a stemming (affix removal) algorithm that reduced the dictionary to 25,000 words. For fast in‑memory lookups, he used a Bloom filter (credited to Dennis Ritchie) tuned to a 1/2000 false positive rate, which avoided disk checks.

When the dictionary grew to 30,000 words, the Bloom filter became impractical. McIlroy switched to storing only 27‑bit hash codes of words. To compress them, he discovered that the differences between sorted hash codes followed a geometric distribution. He applied Golomb coding, achieving 13.60 bits per word—remarkably close to the theoretical minimum of 13.57 bits. Finally, he partitioned the compressed data to accelerate lookups, trading a small memory increase for speed. The solution remains a classic example of engineering under tight constraints, combining linguistic preprocessing, probabilistic data structures, and information‑theoretic compression.

文章详细介绍了道格拉斯·麦基尔罗伊如何在PDP‑11上实现Unix拼写检查器，将250 kB的词典压缩进64 kB的内存中。史蒂夫·约翰逊的初始原型依赖磁盘查找，既慢又不准确。麦基尔罗伊首先构建了一个词干提取（去除词缀）算法，将词典缩减至25,000个单词。为了实现快速的内存查找，他使用了布隆过滤器（归功于丹尼斯·里奇），并将其误报率调整为1/2000，从而避免了磁盘检查。

当词典增至30,000个单词时，布隆过滤器变得不切实际。麦基尔罗伊转而只存储单词的27位哈希码。为了压缩这些哈希码，他发现排序后的哈希码差值服从几何分布。他应用哥伦布编码，实现了每个单词13.60位的压缩效率——非常接近理论最小值13.57位。最后，他对压缩数据进行了分区以加速查找，以少量内存增加换取了速度提升。该方案至今仍是资源严苛条件下工程设计的经典范例，融合了语言预处理、概率数据结构和信息论压缩技术。

title: We have proof automation now
summary:
The article discusses how large language models (LLMs) could revolutionize proof automation in dependently-typed languages like Lean, making them far more practical for real-world programming. The author recalls the historical burden of proof effort—citing the seL4 project, which spent 10× more time on proofs than implementation—and traditional automation approaches like F*’s SMT solvers, which can be unpredictable.

To illustrate, the author implemented a Zstandard decompressor in Lean. Zstandard uses two entropy coders: Huffman trees (whole-bit codes) and FSE (a state machine that allows fractional-bit efficiency by assigning multiple states to common symbols). FSE encodes backwards, requiring careful table construction.

Lean is highlighted as a strict, pure functional language with convenient monadic do notation and efficient in-place mutation via reference counting (though without linear types). The author argues that by combining dependent types with LLM-powered proof generation, the costly “proof engineering” overhead can be dramatically reduced, opening the door to enforce subtle invariants with machine-checked correctness at a fraction of the current cost.

title: Using sed to make indexes for books (1997)
summary:
Eric Pement describes using `sed` to automate book index creation from a sorted input file. Each line initially contained an index term and page number separated by a semicolon (e.g., `Buddhism, Zen; 1`). After sorting with GNU `sort` using case-insensitive and numeric options (`sort -t";" +0f -1 +1n input.file`), the goal was to merge consecutive lines with the same term into one line with comma-separated page numbers (e.g., `Adam, 13, 21, 30-32`).

Pement developed a `sed` script (`INDEXER.SED`) that reads lines into the pattern buffer, uses `N` to append the next line, and attempts a substitution `s/^\([^;]*;\) \(.*\)\n\1 \(.*\)/\1 \2, \3/`. If the two lines share the same term (captured by `\1`), the newline and repeated term are removed, appending page numbers. The `t loop` branches back to combine more matching lines. When terms differ, the first line’s semicolon is replaced with a comma (`s/;/,/`), printed with `P`, and deleted with `D`, leaving the next line in the buffer.

A critical flaw: if any input line lacks a semicolon, the script fails, as the substitution on line 6 inadvertently deletes the semicolon from the subsequent line, corrupting the entire output. Pement offers two fixes: (1) add error-checking code that halts the script on missing or double semicolons, displaying an error and line number; (2) restrict the comma substitution to only the first line using a more specific pattern. He recommends the first approach for robustness.

The final script includes validation checks and the main loop, demonstrating `sed`’s utility for text processing in publishing workflows.
chinese_title: 使用sed制作书籍索引（1997）
chinese_summary:
Eric Pement描述了如何使用`sed`从已排序的输入文件中自动创建书籍索引。每行最初包含一个索引词和页码，用分号分隔（例如`Buddhism, Zen; 1`）。使用GNU `sort`的忽略大小写和数字选项进行排序后（`sort -t";" +0f -1 +1n input.file`），目标是将相同索引词的连续行合并为一行，页码用逗号分隔（例如`Adam, 13, 21, 30-32`）。

Pement编写了一个`sed`脚本（`INDEXER.SED`），将行读入模式缓冲区，使用`N`追加下一行，并尝试替换`s/^\([^;]*;\) \(.*\)\n\1 \(.*\)/\1 \2, \3/`。如果两行具有相同的索引词（由`\1`捕获），则删除换行符和重复的索引词，并追加页码。`t loop`分支返回以合并更多匹配的行。当索引词不同时，将第一行的分号替换为逗号（`s/;/,/`），用`P`打印，并用`D`删除，使下一行留在缓冲区中。

一个关键缺陷：如果任何输入行缺少分号，脚本就会失败，因为第6行的替换会无意中删除后续行的分号，从而破坏整个输出。Pement提供了两种修复方法：（1）添加错误检查代码，当缺少分号或出现双分号时停止脚本，并显示错误信息和行号；（2）使用更具体的模式将逗号替换限制为仅第一行。他推荐第一种方法以保证健壮性。

最终脚本包含了验证检查和主循环，展示了`sed`在出版工作流程中用于文本处理的实用性。

title: Why I Left Google DeepMind
summary:
**Summary of "Why I Left Google DeepMind"**

Alexander Matt Turner explains his resignation from Google DeepMind (GDM) due to the company's entanglements with U.S. Department of Homeland Security (DHS) agencies (ICE) and a subsequent unethical military AI deal with the Pentagon.

After DHS officers killed two civilians, Turner discovered Google provided cloud services to ICE. He launched a campaign to push Google to divest, beginning with an email to senior leaders (Sundar Pichai, Demis Hassabis, Thomas Kurian), which went unanswered.

The crisis deepened when the Pentagon pressured Anthropic to remove contract restrictions against lethal autonomous weapons and mass surveillance, threatening to designate them a "supply chain risk." Turner tried mobilizing prominent AI figures at the IASEAI conference—including Stuart Russell, Yoshua Bengio, and Geoffrey Hinton—to publicly support Anthropic and push back. Russell agreed to act but then backed down; Bengio's office declined; Hinton was unreachable.

Turner also approached Jeff Dean, who had signed a 2018 pledge against killer robots. While Dean co-signed a brief supporting Anthropic, Turner says Dean did not use his leverage to stop Google from signing its own deal.

Turner drafted a 25-page proposal with ethical contract language and oversight mechanisms, praised by experts, but it was ignored until Google signed a deal with *weaker* restrictions than OpenAI's—no prohibitions on killer robots or mass surveillance.

Concluding that Google's leadership had failed to uphold their AI ethics promises under government pressure, Turner left the company in good conscience. The essay serves as a cautionary tale about how powerful institutions abandoned their principles when faced with coercion.
chinese_title: 我为什么离开谷歌DeepMind
chinese_summary:
《我为何离开谷歌DeepMind》摘要

亚历山大·马特·特纳解释了他从谷歌DeepMind（GDM）辞职的原因，源于该公司与美国国土安全部（DHS）下属机构（ICE）的纠葛，以及随后与五角大楼达成的一项不道德的军事AI协议。

在DHS官员杀害两名平民后，特纳发现谷歌向ICE提供云服务。他发起了一场推动谷歌剥离相关业务的运动，首先向高级领导层（桑达尔·皮查伊、德米斯·哈萨比斯、托马斯·库里安）发送邮件，但未获回应。

危机升级源于五角大楼施压Anthropic公司，要求其移除合同中关于禁止致命自主武器和大规模监控的条款，并威胁将其列为“供应链风险”。特纳试图在IASEAI会议上动员斯图尔特·罗素、约书亚·本吉奥和杰弗里·辛顿等知名AI人士公开支持Anthropic并予以反击。罗素答应行动但随后退缩；本吉奥办公室拒绝；辛顿联系不上。

特纳还联系了曾签署2018年反对杀人机器人的杰夫·迪恩。迪恩虽联署了一份支持Anthropic的简短声明，但特纳指出，迪恩并未利用其影响力阻止谷歌签署自己的协议。

特纳起草了一份包含道德合同条款和监督机制的25页提案，受到专家好评，却被忽视——直到谷歌签署了一项比OpenAI限制更弱的协议：未禁止杀人机器人或大规模监控。

特纳得出结论，谷歌领导层在政府压力下未能坚守其AI伦理承诺，因此他问心无愧地离开了公司。这篇文章是一个警示故事，讲述了强大的机构在面对胁迫时如何放弃原则。

title: Work out daily? OK, but how socially fit are you? (2023)
summary:
The article, based on an interview with Robert Waldinger, director of the Harvard Study of Adult Development, highlights that good relationships are the strongest predictor of both happiness and physical health—more than cholesterol, blood pressure, wealth, or fame. The study, running since 1938, found that satisfaction in relationships, especially marriages, best predicted a healthy and happy life at age 80. Loneliness, Waldinger explains, acts as a chronic stressor, keeping the body in a low-level fight-or-flight state, leading to inflammation and worn-down body systems. He notes loneliness is as dangerous to health as smoking half a pack of cigarettes a day or being obese.

The article emphasizes "social fitness"—the need to actively maintain social connections through small actions like texting someone you miss or joining a group activity you enjoy. It's never too late to build meaningful relationships, and everyone needs at least one solid confidant they can count on. Waldinger concludes that while no one is happy all the time, strengthening relationships builds a safety net to weather life's challenges.
chinese_title: 每天锻炼？不错，但你的社交健康度如何？（2023）
chinese_summary:
基于对哈佛成人发展研究主任罗伯特·瓦尔丁格的访谈，本文指出良好关系是幸福感和身体健康的最强预测指标——其重要性超过胆固醇、血压、财富或名声。这项始于1938年的研究发现，人际关系（尤其是婚姻）的满意度最能预测一个人在80岁时是否拥有健康快乐的生活。瓦尔丁格解释称，孤独感是一种慢性压力源，使身体持续处于低水平的“战斗或逃跑”状态，从而导致炎症和身体系统受损。他指出，孤独对健康的危害等同于每天吸半包烟或肥胖。

文章强调了“社交健身”——即通过一些微小行动（如给思念的人发条信息、参加你喜欢的团体活动）来主动维护社交关系。建立有意义的关系永远不嫌晚，每个人都至少需要一个可以信赖的坚实知己。瓦尔丁格总结道，虽然没有人能永远快乐，但加强人际关系可以构建一个安全网，帮助我们渡过生活的难关。
